en: The postcard features an ornate design with a royal coat of arms at the top, artistic elements such as a palette and brush, and coins or medallions. It prominently displays decorative Cyrillic and Latin script, including the name 'Onorio Marcolesco,' described as a court photographer for the Prince of Bulgaria. The towns 'Търново' (Tarnovo, now Veliko Tarnovo) and 'Руссе' (Rousse, now Ruse) are mentioned, likely indicating locations of the photographer's studios. The rest of the postcard has handwritten annotations in both Cyrillic and Latin script at the sides.
